verdict.rationale: Users can explicitly delete documents or entire indexes through the indexing API (moss-docs-22) and unload indexes from memory (moss-docs-18). Running and embedding on-device (moss-docs-4, moss-docs-17) gives some control over where data lives, while the optional disk cache (moss-docs-24) adds data the user must manage. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or configurable retention windows, guarantees about cloud-side deletion and backup purging, account or project-level data deletion, cache-clearing controls, and independent corroboration.
